name: Mud
description: Soft ground that takes the foot and gives it back slowly.

name: Shallow Water
description: Water to the knee or the waist: every stride is a wade.

name: Decking
description: Loose boards, wet planking, a rolling deck; nothing underfoot stays still.

name: Loose Stone
description: Scree and shingle that slides under weight.

name: Rubble
description: Fallen masonry and broken timber to be climbed over or picked through.

name: Undergrowth
description: Brambles, roots and thicket that catch at the legs.

name: Snow
description: Deep enough to swallow the foot at every step.

name: Ice
description: A sheet that gives no purchase; every step is placed, not taken.

name: Sand
description: Dry and shifting, so that half of every stride is lost.

name: Other
description: Difficult ground of no named kind: the GM's catch-all.
